### Libraries and Paths

```{r libraries-paths}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(data.table)
library(ggpattern)
library(forcats)
source("/restricted/projectnb/pcga/DNA_Seq_Combined_Analysis/Project/Scripts/readData.R")

data_dir <- "/restricted/projectnb/pcga/DNA_Seq_Combined_Analysis/Project/Data"
```

### Load Input Data

```{r load-data}
pcga.file <- read.delim(file.path(data_dir, "20200201_PCGA_Exome_with_MuTect2PON.maf"))
pcga.file$Tumor_Sample_Barcode <- substr(pcga.file$Tumor_Sample_Barcode,1,30)

exonic.vars <- c("Silent", "Frame_Shift_Del", "Frame_Shift_Ins", "In_Frame_Del", "In_Frame_Ins", 
                 "Missense_Mutation", "Nonsense_Mutation", "Nonstop_Mutation", "Translation_Start_Site",
                 "Splice_Site", "De_novo_Start_InFrame", "De_novo_Start_OutOfFrame", "Stop_Codon_Del", 
                 "Stop_Codon_Ins", "Start_Codon_Del", "Start_Codon_Ins")

pcga.file <- pcga.file[pcga.file$Variant_Classification %in% exonic.vars,]
```

### Overlapping Set of Mutations

```{r find-overlaps}
pcga.dat <- pcga.file[, c("Tumor_Sample_Barcode", "Hugo_Symbol",
                           "Chromosome", "Start_position", "End_position",
                           "Reference_Allele", "Tumor_Seq_Allele2")]

pcga.dat$Patient_code <- substr(pcga.dat$Tumor_Sample_Barcode, 9, 12)

head(pcga.dat)

setDT(pcga.dat)

all_samples <- unique(pcga.dat$Tumor_Sample_Barcode)
n_samples   <- length(all_samples)
n_pairs     <- n_samples * (n_samples - 1L) / 2L

results_list <- vector("list", n_pairs)
pair_idx     <- 0L

for (i in seq_len(n_samples - 1L)) {

  sample.1  <- all_samples[i]
  samp1.dat <- pcga.dat[Tumor_Sample_Barcode == sample.1,
                        .(Chromosome, Start_position, End_position,
                          Reference_Allele, Tumor_Seq_Allele2)]

  samp1.dat[, key := paste(Chromosome, Start_position, End_position,
                           Reference_Allele, Tumor_Seq_Allele2, sep = ":::")]

  for (j in (i + 1L):n_samples) {

    sample.2  <- all_samples[j]
    samp2.dat <- pcga.dat[Tumor_Sample_Barcode == sample.2,
                          .(Chromosome, Start_position, End_position,
                            Reference_Allele, Tumor_Seq_Allele2)]

    samp2.dat[, key := paste(Chromosome, Start_position, End_position,
                             Reference_Allele, Tumor_Seq_Allele2, sep = ":::")]

    n_overlaps <- nrow(merge(samp1.dat, samp2.dat, by = "key"))

    pair_idx <- pair_idx + 1L
    results_list[[pair_idx]] <- data.frame(
      pair            = paste0(sample.1, ":", sample.2),
      same_patient    = substr(sample.1, 9, 12) == substr(sample.2, 9, 12),
      num_of_overlaps = n_overlaps,
      mut_samp1       = nrow(samp1.dat),
      mut_samp2       = nrow(samp2.dat),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
}

overlap_sets <- do.call(rbind, results_list)

```

### Test Statistical Significance of Overlaps

```{r fisher-test}
total <- length(unique(
  paste(pcga.dat$Chromosome,
        pcga.dat$Start_position,
        pcga.dat$End_position,
        pcga.dat$Reference_Allele,
        pcga.dat$Tumor_Seq_Allele2,
        sep = ":::")
))
results <- vector("list", nrow(overlap_sets))
for (x in seq_len(nrow(overlap_sets))) {

  a <- overlap_sets$num_of_overlaps[x]
  b <- overlap_sets$mut_samp1[x] - a   # in S1 only
  c <- overlap_sets$mut_samp2[x] - a   # in S2 only
  d <- total - a - b - c               # in neither

  M <- matrix(
    c(a, b, 
      c, d), 
    nrow = 2, ncol = 2,
    byrow = TRUE,
    dimnames = list(
      c("S1 mutated", "S1 not mutated"),
      c("S2 mutated", "S2 not mutated")
    )
  )
    results[[x]] <- fisher.test(M, alternative = "greater")$p.value
}

names(results) <- overlap_sets$pair
results_df          <- tibble::enframe(results, name = "pair", value = "p.value")
results_df$p.value  <- unlist(results_df$p.value)
results_df$FDR      <- p.adjust(results_df$p.value, method = "fdr")
```

### Plot Significant Overlaps Across Sample Pairs

```{r plot-results, fig.width=3.5, fig.height=2.5, fig.align='center', fig.dpi=300, fig.cap="Figure 2B", message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
plot_data <- merge(results_df, overlap_sets[, c("pair", "num_of_overlaps", "same_patient", "mut_samp1",
                                                "mut_samp2")], by = "pair")
plot_data$`q-value` = -log10(plot_data$FDR)
head(plot_data)

df <- plot_data[plot_data$num_of_overlaps > 1, ] %>% 
  select(., c(1, 3:5)) %>% 
  mutate(Significance = ifelse(FDR < 0.05, "Clonally related", "Clonally independent"),
         same_patient = ifelse(same_patient, "Within patient", "Across patients")) %>%
  rename("Sample pairing" = same_patient) %>%
  arrange(desc(num_of_overlaps))

df$pair <- gsub("[0-9]*:","\n",df$pair)

gg = ggplot(data = df, aes(x=forcats::fct_reorder(pair, as.numeric(rownames(df))), 
                           y = num_of_overlaps, 
                           fill = Significance,
                           color = `Sample pairing`)) + 
  geom_col_pattern(aes(pattern = `Sample pairing`),
                   position = position_dodge(preserve = "single"),
                   width = 0.8, linewidth = 0.5, color = "black", 
                   pattern_fill = "black",
                   pattern_angle = 90,
                   pattern_density = 0.001,
                   pattern_spacing = 0.025,
                   pattern_key_scale_factor = 0.6) + 
  scale_pattern_manual(
    values = c(
      "Within patient"  = "stripe",
      "Across patients" = "none"
    )
  ) +
  theme_classic() + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 25, hjust = 1, family = "Helvetica", size = 3, colour = "black"), 
        axis.text.y = element_text(family = "Helvetica", size = 3, colour = "black"), 
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 5, family = "Helvetica"), 
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 5, family = "Helvetica"), 
        legend.title = element_text(size = 5, family = "Helvetica"), 
        legend.text = element_text(size = 4, family = "Helvetica"),
        axis.ticks.x = element_line(linewidth = 0.25), 
        axis.ticks.y = element_line(linewidth = 0.25),
        #legend.position = c(0.65, 0.75),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.2,"cm"),
        legend.spacing = unit(0.01, "cm"),
        plot.margin = unit(c(0.2,0,0,0.5), "cm")) + 
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0)) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("grey", "red3")) +  
  scale_color_manual(values = c(NA, "black")) +  # Black outline for TRUE, no outline for FALSE
  labs(y = "# overlapping mutations", x = "Samples pair", 
       fill = "FET-FDR < 0.05") +   
  theme(
    axis.line.x = element_line(linewidth = 0.3),
    axis.line.y = element_line(linewidth = 0.3) 
  ) + guides(pattern = guide_legend(override.aes = list(fill = "grey")))
print(gg)
```
